content_text_body:
Employees who feel valued and cared for are more likely to be engaged, feel happier in their roles, and go the extra mile for the success of the company. Everyday actions can mark a difference in the lives of your employees, so your goal is to nurture a culture of caring where your team members feel included and appreciated. 

First, read this article on [ways to build a culture of caring](https://www.inc.com/adam-fridman/5-ways-to-build-a-culture-of-caring.html) to recognize which recommendations you can start implementing with your team.

### Remember to encourage your employees to be their best 

To do this, you need to connect with them. Take time to know them and learn about their aspirations and career goals. Empower them by providing them with tools that can help them move forward in their professional pathways. Recommend development opportunities including workshops, mentoring sessions, academic programs, etc.    

### Show you care about their personal lives

Help them with personal situations to the best of your abilities. For example, be flexible with the work schedule and work place if this can alleviate a personal situation they are experiencing. Let them know you understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance and make time for meaningful dialogue. 

### Recognize their efforts 

Establish a way to recognize their efforts to contribute to the company's success (e.g. acknowledge them in meetings, give them immediate feedback, send a message through the company communication platform). This will show them you appreciate their investment and they matter to the growth of the team and the organization.

resources.title: ways to build a culture of caring
